day:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create the finished daytime full-bleed background illustration for a cozy alpine fantasy 404 webpage, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1024. Inputs are identity and artistic finish references: first image Melo and flying robot identity; second image alpine painterly world. Create a NEW composition as described here. No text or UI.
A refined, richly detailed storybook digital painting with soft brush textures, expressive furry character, atmospheric lavender mountain layers and warm afternoon lighting. Soft pale blue sky and peach clouds occupy the upper HALF. A large warm pale round sun centered precisely at (50% width, 22% height), diameter 18% of image width. Keep central sky x25-75%, y33-50% nearly clear and pale for a live headline and two short lines of text. Mountains rise only at the far edges there; the central distant horizon starts at y52%.
Melo sits on a mossy rock in the LOWER LEFT, full body contained in x22-43%, y52-86%, studying an unfolded parchment map with a charming puzzled expression, slightly furrowed brows. Preserve the references: fluffy purple fox-like creature, enormous purple ears, cream face and forehead tuft, golden sun forehead mark, violet eyes, purple hoodie with gold drawstrings, cream-tipped purple tail, brown backpack. The tiny white-and-gold spherical robot with dark face, warm expressive eyes, two little wing fins and golden floating ring hovers beside Melo at x44%, y62%.
On the RIGHT, wooden signpost centered x68%, extending y55-89%. Exactly THREE broad blank wooden directional boards, horizontal, almost level, easy to overlay HTML labels. Their flat readable faces should occupy approximately x58-79%, y57-63%, y65-71%, y73-79%, with a central upright post behind. Each board is broad and clean in the middle, warm weathered wood, subtle moss at the ends. No text on boards.
Below clear sky, a winding trail runs into a distant valley and lake, lavender alpine mountains, pine forests, flowers, foliage, mossy rocks. A small warm lantern sits near Melo's rock, around x47% y85%. Foreground flowers and rocks frame the lower corners. Keep every important subject inside x22-79% so this same painting can be cropped centrally on a narrow phone without losing Melo or signpost. Edges can have taller pines, mountains and flowers. The bottom 10% is a soft quiet continuation of the trail with space for two live buttons. Full-bleed painting all the way to all four edges, no vignette frame, no card, no border.
No lettering, numbers, labels, symbols floating in air, question marks, buttons, interface, watermarks.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this completed daytime illustration to improve its center-safe responsive web composition, while preserving its painterly finish, character identities, expressions, poses, lighting and alpine world. Keep landscape 1536x1024. Keep the sun and sky in their existing places, including all the clear central sky for the webpage heading.
Tighten the foreground arrangement towards the CENTER, following these precise normalized coordinates. Make Melo including ALL ears, tail, backpack, feet, rock and map fit entirely inside x27%-45% and y49%-85%. Keep the same puzzled seated pose, map and clothing, simply smaller and moved slightly right so a central mobile crop includes the WHOLE character. The floating robot fits x45%-51%, y55%-65%. The lantern fits x45%-49%, y78%-86%.
Move the entire signpost LEFT slightly and redesign its THREE blank wooden boards to be taller, for live 44px touch links on phones. All three boards must be contained within x55%-73%. Board one exactly y53%-62%; board two y64%-73%; board three y75%-84%. Keep them horizontal with almost flat front-facing readable faces, left pointing ends, warm woodgrain and moss only at edges. Central post x64% from y48%-93%. There are EXACTLY three boards, no lettering.
Make sure ALL essential foreground objects are inside the central x27%-73% safe zone. The far left and far right should remain beautifully painted framing flowers and rocks, but no essential objects there. Fill vacated areas naturally with mountain valley, flowers and trail. Keep clear sky x28%-72%, y28%-47%, and keep the lower center trail quiet for two real buttons. Keep full bleed to all edges, rich warm light and cozy alpine storybook detail. No lettering, numbers, labels, buttons or interface.
night: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the supplied finalized daytime illustration into its matching night variant. This is a strict color-and-light-only edit, not a redraw. Preserve EVERY pixel-level edge, silhouette, object position, shape, scale and pose in this EXACT 1536x1024 composition. Preserve character identity, puzzled face, map folds, ear tips, tail, rock, all board edges, nails, woodgrain, post, lantern, robot, flowers, mountain profiles and cloud shapes. Do not move, resize, add or remove objects. Indigo starry sky, softly moonlit lavender clouds and mountains, blue-violet foliage shadows, warm lantern illumination on existing rock and trail, warm robot eyes and sun mark. Replace the sun with a full moon precisely inside the SAME round silhouette, bounding box x675-852 y83-258, center(763.5,170.5), diameter175 pixels. Do not shrink or move the moon. Only subtle lunar texture inside that identical disk. Keep the middle sky y29%-48% calm dark indigo for pale live webpage copy. Keep three blank wooden boards medium warm brown with readable faces and EXACT same edges and positions. No lettering, labels, numbers, buttons or interface. Retain rich painterly detail without crushed shadows. The day and night images must register perfectly when overlaid.
